steps: Treat API catalog in sources.json as researched choices, not tested credentials. Pin provider schema via checked-in sanitized fixtures and document actual entitlement.

Court filing vs ruling vs resolution; approval vs adverse event; officer vs employee distinction.
Missing credentials surface specific dependency and upload/source alternative.
